title: F — ATOMIC ORDINARY-ACTIVATION CUTOVER
acceptance: F — ATOMIC ORDINARY-ACTIVATION CUTOVER, cap +500. Depends on B/C/D/E together. Wire durable preparation before boot/recovery/runtime target composition and all new-session/host-reader paths; switch every inventoried consumer to acknowledged mapping and remove transitional production legacy bypasses in the same landing. Existing associations migrate with unchanged wire id/ref; new ones use fresh ids. Missing mappings and pending/unhandled/invalid restore evidence hold all relevant admission. No restore rotation caller. Acceptance subset: integrated I2/I3/I6 and ordinary-operation parts of I5/I7, complete boundary matrix, pinned producer identity acceptance. The stage must demonstrate there is no mixed old/new wire identity for a single association and no wire use before ACK. It cannot be split into separate live per-consumer cutovers; if its glue exceeds cap, move more behavior-preserving preparation into preceding dormant stages first. This is the first stage that may enable ordinary fresh issuance.
